+/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*
+ * Fill Colour with Mask Opacity and Transform                                *
+ *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
+
+__STATIC_INLINE
+void __ARM_2D_FUNC(get_alpha_with_opacity)( arm_2d_point_fx_t  *ptFxPoint,
+                                            arm_2d_region_t *ptOrigValidRegion,
+                                            uint8_t *pchOrigin,
+                                            int16_t iOrigStride,
+                                            __API_INT_TYPE *pTarget,
+                                            //int16_t iTargetSride,
+                                            __API_INT_TYPE MaskColour,
+                                            uint_fast16_t hwOpacity)
+{
+#if     defined(__ARM_2D_HAS_ANTI_ALIAS_TRANSFORM__)                          \
+    &&  __ARM_2D_HAS_ANTI_ALIAS_TRANSFORM__ == 1
+
+    arm_2d_location_t  tPoint = {
+        .iX = reinterpret_s16_q16(ptFxPoint->q16X),
+        .iY = reinterpret_s16_q16(ptFxPoint->q16Y),
+    };
+
+    uint16_t hwAlphaX = (ptFxPoint->q16X >> 8) & 0xFF;
+    uint16_t hwAlphaY = (ptFxPoint->q16Y >> 8) & 0xFF;
+
+    uint8_t *pchAlphaSample = &pchOrigin[tPoint.iY * iOrigStride + tPoint.iX];
+
+    uint8_t chPixelAlpha0 = *pchAlphaSample++;
+    uint8_t chPixelAlpha1 = *pchAlphaSample;
+    pchAlphaSample += iOrigStride;
+    uint8_t chPixelAlpha3 = *pchAlphaSample--;
+    uint8_t chPixelAlpha2 = *pchAlphaSample;
+
+    uint16_t hwAlpha1 = (uint32_t)((uint32_t)hwAlphaX * (256 - (uint32_t)hwAlphaY)) >> 8;
+    uint16_t hwAlpha2 = ((256 - hwAlphaX) * hwAlphaY) >> 8;
+    uint16_t hwAlpha3 = hwAlphaX * hwAlphaY >> 8;
+    uint16_t hwAlpha0 = 256 - hwAlpha1 - hwAlpha2 - hwAlpha3;
+
+    uint32_t wTotalAlpha = 0;
+
+    wTotalAlpha += (chPixelAlpha0 == 255) * ((uint32_t)hwAlpha0 << 8) 
+                + (!(chPixelAlpha0 == 255) * chPixelAlpha0 * hwAlpha0);
+
+    wTotalAlpha += (chPixelAlpha1 == 255) * (hwAlpha1 << 8) 
+                + (!(chPixelAlpha1 == 255) * chPixelAlpha1 * hwAlpha1);
+
+    wTotalAlpha += (chPixelAlpha2 == 255) * (hwAlpha2 << 8) 
+                + (!(chPixelAlpha2 == 255) * chPixelAlpha2 * hwAlpha2);
+
+    wTotalAlpha += (chPixelAlpha3 == 255) * (hwAlpha3 << 8) 
+                + (!(chPixelAlpha3 == 255) * chPixelAlpha3 * hwAlpha3);
+
+    if (wTotalAlpha) {
+        uint16_t hwAlpha = (wTotalAlpha >= 0xFF00) * hwOpacity
+                            + (!(wTotalAlpha >= 0xFF00) * (wTotalAlpha * hwOpacity >> 16));
+
+        __API_PIXEL_BLENDING( &MaskColour, pTarget, hwAlpha);
+    }
+
+#else
+
+    arm_2d_location_t  tPoint = {
+        .iX = reinterpret_s16_q16(ptFxPoint->q16X),
+        .iY = reinterpret_s16_q16(ptFxPoint->q16Y),
+    };
+
+    uint32_t wPixelAlpha = 0;
+    //if (arm_2d_is_point_inside_region(ptOrigValidRegion, &tPoint)) {
+        wPixelAlpha = pchOrigin[   tPoint.iY * iOrigStride
+                                     +   tPoint.iX];
+
+        wPixelAlpha =  (wPixelAlpha == 255) * hwOpacity
+                     + !(wPixelAlpha == 255) * (wPixelAlpha * hwOpacity >> 8);
+
+        __API_PIXEL_BLENDING( &MaskColour, pTarget, wPixelAlpha);
+    //}
+
+#endif
+}
+
+
+__WEAK
+void __ARM_2D_FUNC(colour_filling_mask_opacity_transform)(
+                                    __arm_2d_param_copy_orig_t *ptParam,
+                                    __arm_2d_transform_info_t *ptInfo,
+                                    uint_fast16_t hwRatio)
+{
+    int_fast16_t        iHeight = ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tCopySize.iHeight;
+    int_fast16_t        iWidth = ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tCopySize.iWidth;
+
+    int_fast16_t        iTargetStride =
+        ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride;
+    __API_INT_TYPE     *pTargetBase = ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer;
+    uint8_t             *pchOrigin = (uint8_t *)ptParam->tOrigin.pBuffer;
+    int_fast16_t        iOrigStride = ptParam->tOrigin.iStride;
+    __API_INT_TYPE      MaskColour = MASK_COLOR(__API_INT_TYPE_BIT_NUM);
+    float               fAngle = -ptInfo->fAngle;
+    arm_2d_location_t   tOffset =
+        ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tLocation;
+
+    hwRatio += (hwRatio == 255);
+
+    q31_t               invIWidth = iWidth > 1 ? 0x7fffffff / (iWidth - 1) : 0x7fffffff;
+    arm_2d_rot_linear_regr_t regrCoefs[2];
+    arm_2d_location_t   SrcPt = ptInfo->tDummySourceOffset;
+
+    /* get regression parameters over 1st and last column */
+    __arm_2d_transform_regression(
+        &ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tCopySize,
+        &SrcPt,
+        fAngle,
+        ptInfo->fScaleX,
+        ptInfo->fScaleY,
+        &tOffset,
+        &(ptInfo->tCenter),
+        regrCoefs);
+
+    /* slopes between 1st and last cols */
+    int32_t         slopeY, slopeX;
+
+    slopeY =
+        MULTFX((regrCoefs[1].interceptY - regrCoefs[0].interceptY), invIWidth);
+    slopeX =
+        MULTFX((regrCoefs[1].interceptX - regrCoefs[0].interceptX), invIWidth);
+
+    for (int_fast16_t y = 0; y < iHeight; y++) {
+        /* 1st column estimates */
+        int32_t         colFirstY =
+            __QADD((regrCoefs[0].slopeY * y), regrCoefs[0].interceptY);
+        int32_t         colFirstX =
+            __QADD((regrCoefs[0].slopeX * y), regrCoefs[0].interceptX);
+
+
+        for (int_fast16_t x = 0; x < iWidth; x++) {
+            arm_2d_point_fx_t tPointFast;
+
+            tPointFast.q16X = __QDADD(colFirstX, slopeX * x);
+            tPointFast.q16Y = __QDADD(colFirstY, slopeY * x);
+
+#define __CALIBFX 590
+
+        #if !defined(__ARM_2D_CFG_UNSAFE_IGNORE_CALIB_IN_TRANSFORM__)
+            if (tPointFast.q16X > 0) {
+                tPointFast.q16X += __CALIBFX;
+            } else {
+                tPointFast.q16X -= __CALIBFX;
+            }
+            if (tPointFast.q16Y > 0) {
+                tPointFast.q16Y += __CALIBFX;
+            } else {
+                tPointFast.q16Y -= __CALIBFX;
+            }
+        #endif
+
+            arm_2d_location_t tOriginLocation = {
+                .iX = reinterpret_s16_q16(tPointFast.q16X) - ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion.tLocation.iX,
+                .iY = reinterpret_s16_q16(tPointFast.q16Y) - ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion.tLocation.iY,
+            };
+
+            if (    (tOriginLocation.iX < 0)
+                ||  (tOriginLocation.iY < 0)
+                ||  (tOriginLocation.iX >= (ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion.tSize.iWidth - 1))
+                ||  (tOriginLocation.iY >= (ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion.tSize.iHeight - 1))) {
+                pTargetBase++;
+                continue;
+            }
+
+            __ARM_2D_FUNC(get_alpha_with_opacity) (
+                            &tPointFast,
+                            &ptParam->tOrigin.
+                            tValidRegion,
+                            pchOrigin,
+                            iOrigStride,
+                            pTargetBase,
+                            MaskColour,
+                            hwRatio);
+            pTargetBase++;
+        }
+        pTargetBase += (iTargetStride - iWidth);
+    }
+}
+
+
+
+__STATIC_INLINE
+void __ARM_2D_FUNC(get_chn_alpha_with_opacity)( arm_2d_point_fx_t  *ptFxPoint,
+                                            arm_2d_region_t *ptOrigValidRegion,
+                                            uint32_t *pwOrigin,
+                                            int16_t iOrigStride,
+                                            __API_INT_TYPE *pTarget,
+                                            //int16_t iTargetSride,
+                                            __API_INT_TYPE MaskColour,
+                                            uint_fast16_t hwOpacity)
+{
+#if     defined(__ARM_2D_HAS_ANTI_ALIAS_TRANSFORM__)                          \
+    &&  __ARM_2D_HAS_ANTI_ALIAS_TRANSFORM__ == 1
+
+    arm_2d_location_t  tPoint = {
+        .iX = reinterpret_s16_q16(ptFxPoint->q16X),
+        .iY = reinterpret_s16_q16(ptFxPoint->q16Y),
+    };
+
+    uint16_t hwAlphaX = (ptFxPoint->q16X >> 8) & 0xFF;
+    uint16_t hwAlphaY = (ptFxPoint->q16Y >> 8) & 0xFF;
+
+    uint32_t *pwAlphaSample = &pwOrigin[tPoint.iY * iOrigStride + tPoint.iX];
+
+    uint8_t chPixelAlpha0 = *(uint8_t *)(pwAlphaSample++);
+    uint8_t chPixelAlpha1 = *(uint8_t *)pwAlphaSample;
+    pwAlphaSample += iOrigStride;
+    uint8_t chPixelAlpha3 = *(uint8_t *)(pwAlphaSample--);
+    uint8_t chPixelAlpha2 = *(uint8_t *)pwAlphaSample;
+
+    uint16_t hwAlpha1 = (hwAlphaX * (256 - hwAlphaY)) >> 8;
+    uint16_t hwAlpha2 = ((256 - hwAlphaX) * hwAlphaY) >> 8;
+    uint16_t hwAlpha3 = hwAlphaX * hwAlphaY >> 8;
+    uint16_t hwAlpha0 = 256 - hwAlpha1 - hwAlpha2 - hwAlpha3;
+
+    uint32_t wTotalAlpha = 0;
+
+    wTotalAlpha += (chPixelAlpha0 == 255) * ((uint32_t)hwAlpha0 << 8) 
+                + (!(chPixelAlpha0 == 255) * chPixelAlpha0 * hwAlpha0);
+
+    wTotalAlpha += (chPixelAlpha1 == 255) * (hwAlpha1 << 8) 
+                + (!(chPixelAlpha1 == 255) * chPixelAlpha1 * hwAlpha1);
+
+    wTotalAlpha += (chPixelAlpha2 == 255) * (hwAlpha2 << 8) 
+                + (!(chPixelAlpha2 == 255) * chPixelAlpha2 * hwAlpha2);
+
+    wTotalAlpha += (chPixelAlpha3 == 255) * (hwAlpha3 << 8) 
+                + (!(chPixelAlpha3 == 255) * chPixelAlpha3 * hwAlpha3);
+
+    if (wTotalAlpha) {
+        uint16_t hwAlpha = (wTotalAlpha >= 0xFF00) * hwOpacity
+                            + (!(wTotalAlpha >= 0xFF00) * (wTotalAlpha * hwOpacity >> 16));
+
+        __API_PIXEL_BLENDING( &MaskColour, pTarget, hwAlpha);
+    }
+
+#else
+
+    arm_2d_location_t  tPoint = {
+        .iX = reinterpret_s16_q16(ptFxPoint->q16X),
+        .iY = reinterpret_s16_q16(ptFxPoint->q16Y),
+    };
+
+    uint32_t wPixelAlpha = 0;
+    //if (arm_2d_is_point_inside_region(ptOrigValidRegion, &tPoint)) {
+        wPixelAlpha = *(uint8_t *)&pwOrigin[ tPoint.iY * iOrigStride + tPoint.iX];
+
+        wPixelAlpha =  (wPixelAlpha == 255) * hwOpacity
+                     + !(wPixelAlpha == 255) * (wPixelAlpha * hwOpacity >> 8);
+
+        __API_PIXEL_BLENDING( &MaskColour, pTarget, wPixelAlpha);
+    //}
+
+#endif
+}
+
+
+__WEAK
+void __ARM_2D_FUNC(colour_filling_chn_mask_opacity_transform)(
+                                    __arm_2d_param_copy_orig_t *ptParam,
+                                    __arm_2d_transform_info_t *ptInfo,
+                                    uint_fast16_t hwRatio)
+{
+    int_fast16_t        iHeight = ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tCopySize.iHeight;
+    int_fast16_t        iWidth = ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tCopySize.iWidth;
+
+    int_fast16_t        iTargetStride =
+        ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride;
+    __API_INT_TYPE     *pTargetBase = ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer;
+    uint32_t           *pwOrigin = (uint32_t *)ptParam->tOrigin.pBuffer;
+    int_fast16_t        iOrigStride = ptParam->tOrigin.iStride;
+    __API_INT_TYPE      MaskColour = MASK_COLOR(__API_INT_TYPE_BIT_NUM);
+    float               fAngle = -ptInfo->fAngle;
+    arm_2d_location_t   tOffset =
+        ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tLocation;
+
+    hwRatio += (hwRatio == 255);
+
+    q31_t               invIWidth = iWidth > 1 ? 0x7fffffff / (iWidth - 1) : 0x7fffffff;
+    arm_2d_rot_linear_regr_t regrCoefs[2];
+    arm_2d_location_t   SrcPt = ptInfo->tDummySourceOffset;
+
+    /* get regression parameters over 1st and last column */
+    __arm_2d_transform_regression(
+        &ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tCopySize,
+        &SrcPt,
+        fAngle,
+        ptInfo->fScaleX,
+        ptInfo->fScaleY,
+        &tOffset,
+        &(ptInfo->tCenter),
+        regrCoefs);
+
+    /* slopes between 1st and last cols */
+    int32_t         slopeY, slopeX;
+
+    slopeY =
+        MULTFX((regrCoefs[1].interceptY - regrCoefs[0].interceptY), invIWidth);
+    slopeX =
+        MULTFX((regrCoefs[1].interceptX - regrCoefs[0].interceptX), invIWidth);
+
+    for (int_fast16_t y = 0; y < iHeight; y++) {
+        /* 1st column estimates */
+        int32_t         colFirstY =
+            __QADD((regrCoefs[0].slopeY * y), regrCoefs[0].interceptY);
+        int32_t         colFirstX =
+            __QADD((regrCoefs[0].slopeX * y), regrCoefs[0].interceptX);
+
+
+        for (int_fast16_t x = 0; x < iWidth; x++) {
+            arm_2d_point_fx_t tPointFast;
+
+            tPointFast.q16X = __QDADD(colFirstX, slopeX * x);
+            tPointFast.q16Y = __QDADD(colFirstY, slopeY * x);
+
+#define __CALIBFX 590
+
+        #if !defined(__ARM_2D_CFG_UNSAFE_IGNORE_CALIB_IN_TRANSFORM__)
+            if (tPointFast.q16X > 0) {
+                tPointFast.q16X += __CALIBFX;
+            } else {
+                tPointFast.q16X -= __CALIBFX;
+            }
+            if (tPointFast.q16Y > 0) {
+                tPointFast.q16Y += __CALIBFX;
+            } else {
+                tPointFast.q16Y -= __CALIBFX;
+            }
+        #endif
+
+            arm_2d_location_t tOriginLocation = {
+                .iX = reinterpret_s16_q16(tPointFast.q16X) - ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion.tLocation.iX,
+                .iY = reinterpret_s16_q16(tPointFast.q16Y) - ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion.tLocation.iY,
+            };
+
+            if (    (tOriginLocation.iX < 0)
+                ||  (tOriginLocation.iY < 0)
+                ||  (tOriginLocation.iX >= (ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion.tSize.iWidth - 1))
+                ||  (tOriginLocation.iY >= (ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion.tSize.iHeight - 1))) {
+                pTargetBase++;
+                continue;
+            }
+
+            __ARM_2D_FUNC(get_chn_alpha_with_opacity) (
+                            &tPointFast,
+                            &ptParam->tOrigin.
+                            tValidRegion,
+                            pwOrigin,
+                            iOrigStride,
+                            pTargetBase,
+                            MaskColour,
+                            hwRatio);
+            pTargetBase++;
+        }
+        pTargetBase += (iTargetStride - iWidth);
+    }
+}

+ * Project:      Arm-2D Library
+ * Title:        __arm_2d_transform_helium.inc
+ * Description:  c code template for transform

+
+#ifndef __API_INT_TYPE_BIT_NUM
+#   error You have to define __API_INT_TYPE_BIT_NUM before using this c template
+#endif
+#ifndef __API_COLOUR
+#   error You have to define __API_COLOUR before using this c template
+#endif
+#ifndef __API_COLOUR_NAME
+#   error You have to define __API_COLOUR_NAME before using this c template
+#endif
+
+#undef ____ARM_2D_FUNC
+#undef ___ARM_2D_FUNC
+#undef __ARM_2D_FUNC
+#define ____ARM_2D_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR)  __MVE_WRAPPER(__arm_2d_impl_##__COLOUR##_##__NAME)
+#define ___ARM_2D_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR)   ____ARM_2D_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR)
+#define __ARM_2D_FUNC(__NAME)   ___ARM_2D_FUNC(__NAME, __API_COLOUR_NAME)
+
+
+
+#define __API_INT_TYPE   ARM_PIX_SCLTYP(__API_INT_TYPE_BIT_NUM)
+
+#define MASK_COLOR(sz)  (sz == 8) ? ptInfo->Mask.chColour : ((sz == 16) ?  ptInfo->Mask.hwColour :  ptInfo->Mask.wColour)
+
+
+__OVERRIDE_WEAK
+void __ARM_2D_FUNC(transform)(  __arm_2d_param_copy_orig_t *ptParam,
+                                __arm_2d_transform_info_t *ptInfo)
+{
+    int32_t         iHeight = ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tCopySize.iHeight;
+    int32_t         iWidth = ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tCopySize.iWidth;
+    int32_t         iTargetStride =
+        ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride;
+    __API_INT_TYPE  *pTargetBase = ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer;
+    __API_INT_TYPE  *pOrigin = ptParam->tOrigin.pBuffer;
+    int32_t         iOrigStride = ptParam->tOrigin.iStride;
+    __API_INT_TYPE   MaskColour = MASK_COLOR(__API_INT_TYPE_BIT_NUM);
+    float32_t        fAngle = -ptInfo->fAngle;
+    arm_2d_location_t tOffset =
+        ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tLocation;
+    arm_2d_point_float_t *pCenter = &(ptInfo->tCenter);
+    q31_t           invIWidth = (iWidth > 1) ? 0x7fffffff / (iWidth - 1) : 0x7fffffff;
+    arm_2d_rot_linear_regr_t    regrCoefs[2];
+    arm_2d_location_t           SrcPt = ptInfo->tDummySourceOffset;
+
+    /* get regression parameters over 1st and last column */
+#if __API_COLOUR == ARM_2D_M_COLOUR_RGB565
+    bool            gatherLoadIdxOverflow;
+
+    gatherLoadIdxOverflow =
+#endif
+    __arm_2d_transform_regression(
+        &ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tCopySize,
+        &SrcPt,
+        fAngle,
+        ptInfo->fScaleX,
+        ptInfo->fScaleY,
+        &tOffset,
+        pCenter,
+        iOrigStride,
+        regrCoefs);
+
+
+    /* slopes between 1st and last columns */
+    int32_t         slopeY, slopeX;
+
+    slopeY =
+        MULTFX((regrCoefs[1].interceptY - regrCoefs[0].interceptY), invIWidth);
+    slopeX =
+        MULTFX((regrCoefs[1].interceptX - regrCoefs[0].interceptX), invIWidth);
+
+    int32_t         nrmSlopeX = 17 - __CLZ(ABS(slopeX));
+    int32_t         nrmSlopeY = 17 - __CLZ(ABS(slopeY));
+
+    slopeX = ARSHIFT(slopeX, nrmSlopeX);
+    slopeY = ARSHIFT(slopeY, nrmSlopeY);
+
+#if __API_COLOUR == ARM_2D_M_COLOUR_RGB565
+    if (!gatherLoadIdxOverflow) {
+
+#endif
+    for (int32_t y = 0; y < iHeight; y++) {
+
+        /* 1st column estimates */
+        int32_t         colFirstY =
+            __QADD((regrCoefs[0].slopeY * y), regrCoefs[0].interceptY);
+        int32_t         colFirstX =
+            __QADD((regrCoefs[0].slopeX * y), regrCoefs[0].interceptX);
+
+        /* Q6 conversion */
+        colFirstX = colFirstX >> 10;
+        colFirstY = colFirstY >> 10;

+            tPointTemp.Y = tPointV.Y >> 6;
+            mve_pred16_t p = arm_2d_is_point_vec_inside_region_s16_safe(

+    }    else {

+            int32_t         colFirstY =

+            colFirstY = colFirstY >> 10;

+            __API_INT_TYPE     *pTargetBaseCur = pTargetBase;

+                tPointV.Y = vqdmulhq_n_s16(vX, slopeY);

+                tPointTemp.X = tPointV.X >> 6;
+                tPointTemp.Y = tPointV.Y >> 6;

+                if (0xFFFF == p) {

+                        &ptParam->tOrigin.
+                        tValidRegion,

+                        iOrigStride,
+                        pTargetBaseCur,
+                        MaskColour);
+                } else if (0 != p) {

+                        &ptParam->tOrigin.

+                        iOrigStride,
+                        pTargetBaseCur,
+                        MaskColour,

+                }

+                pTargetBaseCur += 8;
+                vX += SET_Q6INT(8);

+            }

+        }
+    }
+#endif

+__OVERRIDE_WEAK
+void __ARM_2D_FUNC(transform_with_opacity)(   __arm_2d_param_copy_orig_t *ptParam,
+                                    __arm_2d_transform_info_t *ptInfo,
+                                    uint_fast16_t hwRatio)
+{
+    int32_t         iHeight = ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tCopySize.iHeight;
+    int32_t         iWidth = ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tCopySize.iWidth;

+        ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride;
+    __API_INT_TYPE       *pTargetBase = ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer;
+    __API_INT_TYPE       *pOrigin = ptParam->tOrigin.pBuffer;
+    int32_t         iOrigStride = ptParam->tOrigin.iStride;
+    __API_INT_TYPE        MaskColour = MASK_COLOR(__API_INT_TYPE_BIT_NUM);
+    float           fAngle = -ptInfo->fAngle;
+    arm_2d_location_t tOffset =
+        ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tLocation;
+    arm_2d_point_float_t *pCenter = &(ptInfo->tCenter);
+

+    arm_2d_location_t SrcPt = ptInfo->tDummySourceOffset;
+#if !defined(__ARM_2D_CFG_UNSAFE_IGNORE_ALPHA_255_COMPENSATION__)
+    hwRatio += (hwRatio == 255);
+#endif
+
+    /* get regression parameters over 1st and last column */
+#if __API_COLOUR == ARM_2D_M_COLOUR_RGB565
+    bool            gatherLoadIdxOverflow;
+    gatherLoadIdxOverflow =
+#endif
+    __arm_2d_transform_regression(
+        &ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tCopySize,
+        &SrcPt,
+        fAngle,
+        ptInfo->fScaleX,
+        ptInfo->fScaleY,
+        &tOffset,
+        pCenter,
+        iOrigStride,
+        regrCoefs);
+
+
+    /* slopes between 1st and last columns */
+    int32_t         slopeY, slopeX;
+
+    slopeY = MULTFX((regrCoefs[1].interceptY - regrCoefs[0].interceptY), invIWidth);
+    slopeX = MULTFX((regrCoefs[1].interceptX - regrCoefs[0].interceptX), invIWidth);
+
+    int32_t         nrmSlopeX = 17 - __CLZ(ABS(slopeX));
+    int32_t         nrmSlopeY = 17 - __CLZ(ABS(slopeY));
+
+    slopeX = ARSHIFT(slopeX, nrmSlopeX);
+    slopeY = ARSHIFT(slopeY, nrmSlopeY);
+
+#if __API_COLOUR == ARM_2D_M_COLOUR_RGB565
+    if (!gatherLoadIdxOverflow) {
+#endif
+        for (int32_t y = 0; y < iHeight; y++) {
+            /* 1st column estimates */
+            int32_t         colFirstY =
+                __QADD((regrCoefs[0].slopeY * y), regrCoefs[0].interceptY);
+            int32_t         colFirstX =
+                __QADD((regrCoefs[0].slopeX * y), regrCoefs[0].interceptX);
+
+            /* Q6 conversion */
+            colFirstX = colFirstX >> 10;
+            colFirstY = colFirstY >> 10;
+
+            int32_t         nbVecElts = iWidth;
+            int16x8_t       vX = (int16x8_t) vidupq_n_u16(0, 1);
+            __API_INT_TYPE *pTargetBaseCur = pTargetBase;
+
+            /* Q9.6 coversion */
+            vX = SET_Q6INT(vX);
+
+            while (nbVecElts > 0) {
+                /* interpolation */
+                arm_2d_point_s16x8_t tPointV, tPointTemp;
+
+                tPointV.X = vqdmulhq_n_s16(vX, slopeX);
+                tPointV.X = vaddq_n_s16(vqrshlq_n_s16(tPointV.X, nrmSlopeX), colFirstX);
+
+                tPointV.Y = vqdmulhq_n_s16(vX, slopeY);
+                tPointV.Y = vaddq_n_s16(vqrshlq_n_s16(tPointV.Y, nrmSlopeY), colFirstY);
+
+                tPointTemp.X = tPointV.X >> 6;
+                tPointTemp.Y = tPointV.Y >> 6;
+                mve_pred16_t p = arm_2d_is_point_vec_inside_region_s16_safe(
+                                        &ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion, 
+                                        &tPointTemp);
+                p &= vctp16q(nbVecElts);
+                if (0xFFFF == p) {
+                    __ARM_2D_FUNC(get_pixel_colour_with_alpha_inside_src)(
+                                                 &tPointV,
+                                                 &ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion,
+                                                 pOrigin, 
+                                                 iOrigStride,
+                                                 pTargetBaseCur,
+                                                 MaskColour, 
+                                                 hwRatio);
+                } else if (0 != p) {
+                    __ARM_2D_FUNC(get_pixel_colour_with_alpha)(
+                                                 &tPointV,
+                                                 &ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion,
+                                                 pOrigin, 
+                                                 iOrigStride,
+                                                 pTargetBaseCur,
+                                                 MaskColour, 
+                                                 hwRatio,
+                                                 nbVecElts);

+                vX += SET_Q6INT(8);

+            }

+        for (int32_t y = 0; y < iHeight; y++) {

+            int32_t         colFirstY =

+                tPointV.X = vaddq_n_s16(vqrshlq_n_s16(tPointV.X, nrmSlopeX), colFirstX);
+
+                tPointV.Y = vqdmulhq_n_s16(vX, slopeY);
+                tPointV.Y = vaddq_n_s16(vqrshlq_n_s16(tPointV.Y, nrmSlopeY), colFirstY);

+                tPointTemp.X = tPointV.X >> 6;
+                tPointTemp.Y = tPointV.Y >> 6;
+                mve_pred16_t p = arm_2d_is_point_vec_inside_region_s16_safe(
+                                        &ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion, 
+                                        &tPointTemp);
+                p &= vctp16q(nbVecElts);
+                if (0xFFFF == p) {
+                    __MVE_WRAPPER(__arm_2d_impl_rgb565_get_pixel_colour_with_alpha_offs_compensated_inside_src)(
+                                                &tPointV, 
+                                                &ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion, 
+                                                pOrigin, 
+                                                iOrigStride,
+                                                pTargetBaseCur, 
+                                                MaskColour, 
+                                                hwRatio);
+                } else if (0 != p) {
+                    __MVE_WRAPPER(__arm_2d_impl_rgb565_get_pixel_colour_with_alpha_offs_compensated)(
+                                                &tPointV, 
+                                                &ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion, 
+                                                pOrigin, 
+                                                iOrigStride,
+                                                pTargetBaseCur, 
+                                                MaskColour, 
+                                                hwRatio, 
+                                                nbVecElts);
+                }
+
+                pTargetBaseCur += 8;
+                vX += SET_Q6INT(8);
+                nbVecElts -= 8;
+            }
+            pTargetBase += iTargetStride;
+        }
+    }
+#endif
+}

+
+    slopeX = ARSHIFT(slopeX, nrmSlopeX);
+    slopeY = ARSHIFT(slopeY, nrmSlopeY);
+
+#if __API_COLOUR == ARM_2D_M_COLOUR_RGB565
+    if (!gatherLoadIdxOverflow) {
+#endif
+        for (int32_t y = 0; y < iHeight; y++) {
+            /* 1st column estimates */
+            int32_t         colFirstY =
+                __QADD((regrCoefs[0].slopeY * y), regrCoefs[0].interceptY);
+            int32_t         colFirstX =
+                __QADD((regrCoefs[0].slopeX * y), regrCoefs[0].interceptX);
+
+            /* Q6 conversion */
+            colFirstX = colFirstX >> 10;
+            colFirstY = colFirstY >> 10;
+
+            int32_t         nbVecElts = iWidth;
+            int16x8_t       vX = (int16x8_t) vidupq_n_u16(0, 1);
+            __API_INT_TYPE *pTargetBaseCur = pTargetBase;
+
+            /* Q9.6 coversion */
+            vX = SET_Q6INT(vX);
+
+            while (nbVecElts > 0) {
+                /* interpolation */
+                arm_2d_point_s16x8_t tPointV, tPointTemp;
+
+                tPointV.X = vqdmulhq_n_s16(vX, slopeX);
+                tPointV.X = vaddq_n_s16(vqrshlq_n_s16(tPointV.X, nrmSlopeX), colFirstX);
+
+                tPointV.Y = vqdmulhq_n_s16(vX, slopeY);
+                tPointV.Y = vaddq_n_s16(vqrshlq_n_s16(tPointV.Y, nrmSlopeY), colFirstY);
+
+                tPointTemp.X = tPointV.X >> 6;
+                tPointTemp.Y = tPointV.Y >> 6;
+                mve_pred16_t p = arm_2d_is_point_vec_inside_region_s16_safe(
+                                        &ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion, 
+                                        &tPointTemp);
+                p &= vctp16q(nbVecElts);
+                if (0xFFFF == p) {
+
+                    __ARM_2D_FUNC(transform_only_get_pixel_colour_with_alpha_inside_src)(
+                                                &tPointV,
+                                                &ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion,
+                                                pOrigin, 
+                                                iOrigStride,
+                                                pTargetBaseCur,
+                                                hwRatio);
+
+                } else if (0 != p) {
+
+                    __ARM_2D_FUNC(transform_only_get_pixel_colour_with_alpha)(
+                                                &tPointV,
+                                                &ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion,
+                                                pOrigin, 
+                                                iOrigStride,
+                                                pTargetBaseCur,
+                                                hwRatio,
+                                                nbVecElts);
+                }
+
+                pTargetBaseCur += 8;
+                vX += SET_Q6INT(8);
+                nbVecElts -= 8;
+            }
+            pTargetBase += iTargetStride;
+        }
+#if __API_COLOUR == ARM_2D_M_COLOUR_RGB565
+    } else {
+        /*
+           Large image / Large origin offsets
+           Gather load 16-bit could overflow
+           - Y offset needs to be shifted down to avoid overflow
+           - 16-bit gather loads base address is incremented
+
+           Needs to be done in the inner loop.
+           In the case of steep slopes, taking the minimum between the Y extrema could still generate overflows
+         */
+        for (int32_t y = 0; y < iHeight; y++) {
+            /* 1st column estimates */
+            int32_t         colFirstY =
+                __QADD((regrCoefs[0].slopeY * y), regrCoefs[0].interceptY);
+            int32_t         colFirstX =
+                __QADD((regrCoefs[0].slopeX * y), regrCoefs[0].interceptX);
+
+            /* Q6 conversion */
+            colFirstX = colFirstX >> 10;
+            colFirstY = colFirstY >> 10;
+
+            int32_t         nbVecElts = iWidth;
+            int16x8_t       vX = (int16x8_t) vidupq_n_u16(0, 1);
+            uint16_t       *pTargetBaseCur = pTargetBase;
+
+            /* Q9.6 coversion */
+            vX = SET_Q6INT(vX);
+
+            while (nbVecElts > 0) {
+                /* interpolation */
+                arm_2d_point_s16x8_t tPointV, tPointTemp;
+
+                tPointV.X = vqdmulhq_n_s16(vX, slopeX);
+                tPointV.X = vaddq_n_s16(vqrshlq_n_s16(tPointV.X, nrmSlopeX), colFirstX);
+
+                tPointV.Y = vqdmulhq_n_s16(vX, slopeY);
+                tPointV.Y = vaddq_n_s16(vqrshlq_n_s16(tPointV.Y, nrmSlopeY), colFirstY);
+
+
+                tPointTemp.X = tPointV.X >> 6;
+                tPointTemp.Y = tPointV.Y >> 6;
+                mve_pred16_t p = arm_2d_is_point_vec_inside_region_s16_safe(
+                                        &ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion, 
+                                        &tPointTemp);
+                p &= vctp16q(nbVecElts);
+
+                if (0xFFFF == p) {
+                    __MVE_WRAPPER(__arm_2d_impl_rgb565_transform_only_get_pixel_colour_with_alpha_offs_compensated_inside_src)(
+                                                &tPointV, 
+                                                &ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion, 
+                                                pOrigin, 
+                                                iOrigStride,
+                                                pTargetBaseCur, 
+                                                hwRatio);
+                } else if (0 != p) {
+
+                    __MVE_WRAPPER(__arm_2d_impl_rgb565_transform_only_get_pixel_colour_with_alpha_offs_compensated)(
+                                                &tPointV, 
+                                                &ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion, 
+                                                pOrigin, 
+                                                iOrigStride,
+                                                pTargetBaseCur, 
+                                                hwRatio, 
+                                                nbVecElts);
+                }
+
+                pTargetBaseCur += 8;
+                vX += SET_Q6INT(8);
+                nbVecElts -= 8;
+            }
+            pTargetBase += iTargetStride;
+        }
+    }
+#endif
+}

+
+__OVERRIDE_WEAK
+void __ARM_2D_FUNC(colour_filling_mask_opacity_transform)(   __arm_2d_param_copy_orig_t *ptParam,
+                                    __arm_2d_transform_info_t *ptInfo,
+                                    uint_fast16_t hwRatio)
+{
+    int32_t         iHeight = ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tCopySize.iHeight;
+    int32_t         iWidth = ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tCopySize.iWidth;
+
+    int32_t         iTargetStride =
+        ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride;
+    __API_INT_TYPE       *pTargetBase = ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer;
+    uint8_t             *pchOrigin = (uint8_t *)ptParam->tOrigin.pBuffer;
+    int32_t         iOrigStride = ptParam->tOrigin.iStride;
+    __API_INT_TYPE        MaskColour = MASK_COLOR(__API_INT_TYPE_BIT_NUM);
+    float           fAngle = -ptInfo->fAngle;
+    arm_2d_location_t tOffset =
+        ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tLocation;
+    arm_2d_point_float_t *pCenter = &(ptInfo->tCenter);
+
+    q31_t           invIWidth = iWidth > 1 ? 0x7fffffff / (iWidth - 1) : 0x7fffffff;
+    arm_2d_rot_linear_regr_t regrCoefs[2];
+    arm_2d_location_t SrcPt = ptInfo->tDummySourceOffset;
+#if !defined(__ARM_2D_CFG_UNSAFE_IGNORE_ALPHA_255_COMPENSATION__)
+    hwRatio += (hwRatio == 255);
+#endif
+
+    __arm_2d_transform_regression(
+        &ptParam->use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tCopySize,
+        &SrcPt,
+        fAngle,
+        ptInfo->fScaleX,
+        ptInfo->fScaleY,
+        &tOffset,
+        pCenter,
+        iOrigStride,
+        regrCoefs);
+
+
+    /* slopes between 1st and last columns */
+    int32_t         slopeY, slopeX;
+
+    slopeY = MULTFX((regrCoefs[1].interceptY - regrCoefs[0].interceptY), invIWidth);
+    slopeX = MULTFX((regrCoefs[1].interceptX - regrCoefs[0].interceptX), invIWidth);
+
+    int32_t         nrmSlopeX = 17 - __CLZ(ABS(slopeX));
+    int32_t         nrmSlopeY = 17 - __CLZ(ABS(slopeY));
+
+    slopeX = ARSHIFT(slopeX, nrmSlopeX);
+    slopeY = ARSHIFT(slopeY, nrmSlopeY);
+
+
+        for (int32_t y = 0; y < iHeight; y++) {
+            /* 1st column estimates */
+            int32_t         colFirstY =
+                __QADD((regrCoefs[0].slopeY * y), regrCoefs[0].interceptY);
+            int32_t         colFirstX =
+                __QADD((regrCoefs[0].slopeX * y), regrCoefs[0].interceptX);
+
+            /* Q6 conversion */
+            colFirstX = colFirstX >> 10;
+            colFirstY = colFirstY >> 10;
+
+            int32_t         nbVecElts = iWidth;
+            int16x8_t       vX = (int16x8_t) vidupq_n_u16(0, 1);
+            __API_INT_TYPE *pTargetBaseCur = pTargetBase;
+
+            /* Q9.6 coversion */
+            vX = SET_Q6INT(vX);
+
+            while (nbVecElts > 0) {
+                /* interpolation */
+                arm_2d_point_s16x8_t tPointV, tPointTemp;
+
+                tPointV.X = vqdmulhq_n_s16(vX, slopeX);
+                tPointV.X = vaddq_n_s16(vqrshlq_n_s16(tPointV.X, nrmSlopeX), colFirstX);
+
+                tPointV.Y = vqdmulhq_n_s16(vX, slopeY);
+                tPointV.Y = vaddq_n_s16(vqrshlq_n_s16(tPointV.Y, nrmSlopeY), colFirstY);
+
+                tPointTemp.X = tPointV.X >> 6;
+                tPointTemp.Y = tPointV.Y >> 6;
+                mve_pred16_t p = arm_2d_is_point_vec_inside_region_s16_safe(
+                                        &ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion, 
+                                        &tPointTemp);
+                p &= vctp16q(nbVecElts);
+
+                if (0xFFFF == p) {
+                    __ARM_2D_FUNC(get_alpha_with_opacity_inside_src)(  &tPointV,
+                                                            &ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion,
+                                                            pchOrigin, iOrigStride,
+                                                            pTargetBaseCur,
+                                                            MaskColour, 
+                                                            hwRatio);
+                } else if (0 != p) {
+                    __ARM_2D_FUNC(get_alpha_with_opacity)(  &tPointV,
+                                                            &ptParam->tOrigin.tValidRegion,
+                                                            pchOrigin, iOrigStride,
+                                                            pTargetBaseCur,
+                                                            MaskColour, 
+                                                            hwRatio, 
+                                                            nbVecElts);
+                }
+
+                pTargetBaseCur += 8;
+                vX += SET_Q6INT(8);
+                nbVecElts -= 8;
+            }
+            pTargetBase += iTargetStride;
+        }
+}

+

+#define ____MCM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)                                \
+            ___MCM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)
+#define __MCM_OPCODE                                                            \
+            ____MCM_OPCODE(  __API_MCM_OP,                                      \
+                            __API_MCM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE,                    \
+                            __API_MCM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE)
+

+#define ___MCM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                            \

+            ___MCM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MCM_COLOUR, __API_MCM_MIRROR_TYPE)

+#define ___MCM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                              \
+            ____MCM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)

+            ___MCM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MCM_COLOUR, __API_MCM_MIRROR_TYPE)

+#define ___MCM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                             \
+            ____MCM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)

+ARM_NONNULL(2,3)
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MCM_API_FUNC(tile_copy)( __API_MCM_OP_TYPE *ptOP,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptSource,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptTarget,
+                                        const arm_2d_region_t *ptRegion)
+{
+
+    assert(NULL != ptSource);
+    assert(NULL != ptTarget);
+
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MCM_OP_TYPE, ptOP);
+
+#if __ARM_2D_CFG_SUPPORT_CCCA8888_IMPLICIT_CONVERSION__ && defined(RTE_Acceleration_Arm_2D_Alpha_Blending)
+    if (ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, __API_MCM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE) == ARM_2D_CP_MODE_COPY) {
+        arm_2d_tile_t *ptSourceRoot = arm_2d_tile_get_root(ptSource, NULL, NULL);
+        if (NULL == ptSourceRoot) {
+            return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
+        }
+        if (ptSourceRoot->tInfo.bHasEnforcedColour) {
+            switch (ptSourceRoot->tInfo.tColourInfo.chScheme) {
+                case __MCM_COLOR_TYPE(__API_MCM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE):
+                case ARM_2D_COLOUR_CCCA8888:
+                    /* code */
+                    break;
+
+                default:
+                    return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_NOT_SUPPORT;
+                    //break;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+#endif
+
+    if (!__arm_2d_op_acquire((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis)) {
+        return arm_fsm_rt_on_going;
+    }
+
+    //memset(ptThis, 0, sizeof(*ptThis));
+
+    //OP_CORE.ptOp = &ARM_2D_OP_TILE_COPY_ONLY_RGB32;
+    OP_CORE.ptOp = &__MCM_OPCODE;
+
+    this.Target.ptTile = ptTarget;
+    this.Target.ptRegion = ptRegion;
+    this.Source.ptTile = ptSource;
+    this.wMode = ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, __API_MCM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE);
+
+    return __arm_2d_op_invoke((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis);
+}

+
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MCM_SW_FUNC(tile_copy)( __arm_2d_sub_task_t *ptTask)
+{
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MCM_OP_TYPE, ptTask->ptOP);
+    assert(__API_MCM_COLOUR_SZ == OP_CORE.ptOp->Info.Colour.u3ColourSZ);
+
+#if __ARM_2D_CFG_SUPPORT_CCCA8888_IMPLICIT_CONVERSION__                         \
+&&  defined(RTE_Acceleration_Arm_2D_Alpha_Blending)                             \
+&& __API_MCM_SUPPORT_CCCA8888_IMPLICIT_CONVERSION                               
+
+    arm_2d_tile_t *ptSourceRoot = arm_2d_tile_get_root(this.Source.ptTile, NULL, NULL);
+    assert(NULL != ptSourceRoot);
+    if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_CCCA8888 == ptSourceRoot->tInfo.tColourInfo.chScheme) {
+        if (ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, __API_MCM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE) == ARM_2D_CP_MODE_COPY) {
+
+            if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_SZ_8BIT == __API_MCM_COLOUR_SZ) {
+                __arm_2d_impl_ccca8888_to_gray8(
+                                        ptTask->Param.tCopy.tSource.pBuffer,
+                                        ptTask->Param.tCopy.tSource.iStride,
+                                        ptTask->Param.tCopy.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                                        ptTask->Param.tCopy.tTarget.iStride,
+                                        &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+            }
+
+            if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_SZ_16BIT == __API_MCM_COLOUR_SZ) {
+                __arm_2d_impl_ccca8888_to_rgb565(
+                                        ptTask->Param.tCopy.tSource.pBuffer,
+                                        ptTask->Param.tCopy.tSource.iStride,
+                                        ptTask->Param.tCopy.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                                        ptTask->Param.tCopy.tTarget.iStride,
+                                        &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+            }
+
+            if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_SZ_32BIT == __API_MCM_COLOUR_SZ) {
+                __arm_2d_impl_ccca8888_to_cccn888(
+                                        ptTask->Param.tCopy.tSource.pBuffer,
+                                        ptTask->Param.tCopy.tSource.iStride,
+                                        ptTask->Param.tCopy.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                                        ptTask->Param.tCopy.tTarget.iStride,
+                                        &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+            }
+
+            return arm_fsm_rt_cpl;
+        } else {
+            return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_COLOUR;
+        }
+    }
+
+#endif
+
+    __MCM_IMPL_FUNC(copy)    (  ptTask->Param.tCopy.tSource.pBuffer,
+                                ptTask->Param.tCopy.tSource.iStride,
+                                ptTask->Param.tCopy.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                                ptTask->Param.tCopy.tTarget.iStride,
+                                &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+    return arm_fsm_rt_cpl;
+}
+

+

+#undef __MCM_SW_FUNC

+#undef __API_MCM_COLOUR
+#undef __API_MCM_INT_TYPE
+#undef __MCM_COLOR_TYPE
+#undef __API_MCM_SUPPORT_CCCA8888_IMPLICIT_CONVERSION

+

+#define ____MCKM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)                               \
+            ___MCKM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)

+            ____MCKM_OPCODE(  __API_MCKM_OP,                                    \
+                            __API_MCKM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE,                   \
+                            __API_MCKM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE)

+#define ___MCKM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                           \
+            ____MCKM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MCKM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME)                                                \
+            ___MCKM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MCKM_COLOUR, __API_MCKM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+

+#define ___MCKM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                             \
+            ____MCKM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MCKM_SW_FUNC(__NAME)                                                  \

+#define ___MCKM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                            \
+            ____MCKM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)

+ARM_NONNULL(2,3)
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MCKM_API_FUNC(tile_copy_with_colour_keying)( __API_MCKM_OP_TYPE *ptOP,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptSource,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptTarget,
+                                        const arm_2d_region_t *ptRegion,
+                                        __API_MCKM_INT_TYPE tColour)
+{
+
+    assert(NULL != ptSource);
+    assert(NULL != ptTarget);
+
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MCKM_OP_TYPE, ptOP);
+
+    if (!__arm_2d_op_acquire((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis)) {
+        return arm_fsm_rt_on_going;
+    }
+
+    //memset(ptThis, 0, sizeof(*ptThis));
+
+    //OP_CORE.ptOp = &ARM_2D_OP_TILE_COPY_ONLY_RGB32;
+    OP_CORE.ptOp = &__MCKM_OPCODE;
+
+    this.Target.ptTile = ptTarget;
+    this.Target.ptRegion = ptRegion;
+    this.Source.ptTile = ptSource;
+    this.wMode = ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, __API_MCKM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE);
+    this.wColour = tColour;
+
+    return __arm_2d_op_invoke((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis);
+}
+
+
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MCKM_SW_FUNC(tile_copy_with_colour_keying)( __arm_2d_sub_task_t *ptTask)
+{
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MCKM_OP_TYPE, ptTask->ptOP);
+    assert(__API_MCKM_COLOUR_SZ == OP_CORE.ptOp->Info.Colour.u3ColourSZ);
+
+    __MCKM_IMPL_FUNC(cl_key_copy)(  ptTask->Param.tCopy.tSource.pBuffer,
+                                    ptTask->Param.tCopy.tSource.iStride,
+                                    ptTask->Param.tCopy.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                                    ptTask->Param.tCopy.tTarget.iStride,
+                                    &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize,
+                                    (__API_MCKM_INT_TYPE)this.wColour);
+
+    return arm_fsm_rt_cpl;
+}

+/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
+ * Project:      Arm-2D Library
+ * Title:        __arm_2d_meta_copy_with_des_mask_and_mirror.inc
+ * Description:  c code template for tile copy with mirroring and a mask on
+ *               the target side
+ *
+ * $Date:        07. Nov 2022
+ * $Revision:    V.1.0.0

+
+
+#ifndef __API_MCDMM_COLOUR
+#   error You have to define __API_MCDMM_COLOUR before using this c template
+#endif
+#ifndef __API_MCDMM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE

+#endif

+#endif

+#endif
+#ifndef __API_MCDMM_OP
+#   error You have to define __API_MCDMM_OP before using this c template
+#endif
+#ifndef __API_MCDMM_OP_IDX

+#endif

+#endif
+

+#endif
+

+#endif
+

+#endif
+

+#define ___MCDMM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)    __OP##_##__MIRROR##_##__COLOUR
+
+#undef __MCDMM_OPCODE
+#define ____MCDMM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)                               \
+            ___MCDMM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)
+#define __MCDMM_OPCODE                                                           \
+            ____MCDMM_OPCODE(  __API_MCDMM_OP,                                    \
+                            __API_MCDMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE,                   \
+                            __API_MCDMM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE)
+

+#undef ___MCDMM_IMPL_FUNC
+#undef __MCDMM_IMPL_FUNC
+#define ____MCDMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                          \
+            __arm_2d_impl_##__COLOUR##_##__NAME##_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MCDMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                           \
+            ____MCDMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MCDMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME)                                                \
+            ___MCDMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MCDMM_COLOUR, __API_MCDMM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+
+

+#undef ___MCDMM_SW_FUNC
+#undef __MCDMM_SW_FUNC
+#define ____MCDMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                            \
+            __arm_2d_##__COLOUR##_sw_##__NAME##_and_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MCDMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                             \
+            ____MCDMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MCDMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME)                                                  \
+            ___MCDMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MCDMM_COLOUR, __API_MCDMM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+

+#undef ___MCDMM_API_FUNC
+#undef __MCDMM_API_FUNC
+#define ____MCDMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                           \
+            arm_2dp_##__COLOUR##_##__NAME##_and_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MCDMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                            \
+            ____MCDMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MCDMM_API_FUNC(__NAME)                                                 \
+            ___MCDMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MCDMM_COLOUR, __API_MCDMM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+
+
+ARM_NONNULL(2,3)
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MCDMM_API_FUNC(tile_copy_with_des_mask)(
+                                        __API_MCDMM_OP_TYPE *ptOP,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptSource,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptTarget,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptDesMask,
+                                        const arm_2d_region_t *ptRegion)
+{
+    assert(NULL != ptSource);
+    assert(NULL != ptDesMask);
+    assert(NULL != ptTarget);
+
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MCDMM_OP_TYPE, ptOP);
+
+    arm_2d_err_t tErr = __arm_mask_validate(
+                                ptSource, 
+                                NULL,
+                                ptTarget, 
+                                ptDesMask, 
+                                ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, 
+                                            __API_MCDMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE));
+    if (tErr < 0) {
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)tErr;
+    }
+
+    if (!__arm_2d_op_acquire((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis)) {
+        return arm_fsm_rt_on_going;
+    }
+
+    //memset(ptThis, 0, sizeof(*ptThis));
+
+    OP_CORE.ptOp = &__MCDMM_OPCODE;
+
+    this.Target.ptTile = ptTarget;
+    this.Target.ptRegion = ptRegion;
+    this.Source.ptTile = ptSource;
+    this.wMode = ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, __API_MCDMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE);
+    this.Mask.ptSourceSide = NULL;
+    this.Mask.ptTargetSide = ptDesMask;
+
+    return __arm_2d_op_invoke((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis);
+}
+
+
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MCDMM_SW_FUNC(tile_copy_with_des_mask)( __arm_2d_sub_task_t *ptTask)
+{
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MCDMM_OP_TYPE, ptTask->ptOP);
+    assert(__API_MCDMM_COLOUR_SZ == OP_CORE.ptOp->Info.Colour.u3ColourSZ);
+
+    //! this should not happen
+    assert(NULL != this.Mask.ptTargetSide);
+
+    if (ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.bInvalid) {
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
+    }
+
+    if (ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 == ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tColour.chScheme) {
+
+    #if __ARM_2D_CFG_SUPPORT_COLOUR_CHANNEL_ACCESS__
+        /*!  \note 1 horizontal line target mask in ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 is not 
+         *!       supported when ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize.iHeight is larger
+         *!       than 1 line.
+         */
+
+        assert (    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize.iHeight
+               >=   ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize.iHeight);
+
+        __MCDMM_IMPL_FUNC(des_chn_msk_copy)(
+            ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+            ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.iStride,
+
+            ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+            ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride,
+
+
+            ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.pBuffer,
+            ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.iStride,
+            &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+            &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+
+    #else
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_COLOUR;
+    #endif
+
+    } else {
+        assert(     ARM_2D_COLOUR_8BIT 
+              ==    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tColour.chScheme);
+
+        if (ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize.iHeight > 1) {
+            __MCDMM_IMPL_FUNC(des_msk_copy)(
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.iStride,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+        } else {
+            __MCDMM_IMPL_FUNC(1h_des_msk_copy)(
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.iStride,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+        }
+
+    }
+
+    return arm_fsm_rt_cpl;
+}
+
+
+
+#undef ____MCDMM_API_FUNC
+#undef ___MCDMM_API_FUNC
+#undef __MCDMM_API_FUNC
+
+#undef ____MCDMM_SW_FUNC
+#undef ___MCDMM_SW_FUNC
+#undef __MCDMM_SW_FUNC
+
+
+#undef ____MCDMM_IMPL_FUNC
+#undef ___MCDMM_IMPL_FUNC
+#undef __MCDMM_IMPL_FUNC
+
+#undef __API_MCDMM_IO
+#undef __API_MCDMM_MIRROR_TYPE

+#ifndef __API_MCMM_OP_IDX

+#endif

+#endif
+

+#endif
+

+#endif
+
+#undef ____MCMM_OPCODE
+#define ___MCMM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)    __OP##_##__MIRROR##_##__COLOUR
+
+#undef __MCMM_OPCODE
+#define ____MCMM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)                               \
+            ___MCMM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)
+#define __MCMM_OPCODE                                                           \
+            ____MCMM_OPCODE(  __API_MCMM_OP,                                    \
+                            __API_MCMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE,                   \
+                            __API_MCMM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE)
+

+#undef ___MCMM_IMPL_FUNC
+#undef __MCMM_IMPL_FUNC
+#define ____MCMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                          \
+            __arm_2d_impl_##__COLOUR##_##__NAME##_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MCMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                           \
+            ____MCMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MCMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME)                                                \
+            ___MCMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MCMM_COLOUR, __API_MCMM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+
+

+#undef ___MCMM_SW_FUNC
+#undef __MCMM_SW_FUNC
+#define ____MCMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                            \
+            __arm_2d_##__COLOUR##_sw_##__NAME##_and_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MCMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                             \
+            ____MCMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MCMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME)                                                  \
+            ___MCMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MCMM_COLOUR, __API_MCMM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+

+#undef ___MCMM_API_FUNC

+#define ____MCMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                           \
+            arm_2dp_##__COLOUR##_##__NAME##_and_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MCMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                            \
+            ____MCMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MCMM_API_FUNC(__NAME)                                                 \
+            ___MCMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MCMM_COLOUR, __API_MCMM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+
+
+ARM_NONNULL(2,3)
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MCMM_API_FUNC(tile_copy_with_masks)(
+                                        __API_MCMM_OP_TYPE *ptOP,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptSource,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptSrcMask,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptTarget,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptDesMask,
+                                        const arm_2d_region_t *ptRegion)
+{
+    assert(NULL != ptSource);
+    assert(NULL != ptSrcMask);
+    assert(NULL != ptTarget);
+
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MCMM_OP_TYPE, ptOP);
+
+    arm_2d_err_t tErr = __arm_mask_validate(
+                                ptSource, 
+                                ptSrcMask,
+                                ptTarget, 
+                                ptDesMask, 
+                                ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, 
+                                            __API_MCMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE));
+    if (tErr < 0) {
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)tErr;
+    }
+
+    if (!__arm_2d_op_acquire((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis)) {
+        return arm_fsm_rt_on_going;
+    }
+
+    //memset(ptThis, 0, sizeof(*ptThis));
+
+    OP_CORE.ptOp = &__MCMM_OPCODE;
+
+    this.Target.ptTile = ptTarget;
+    this.Target.ptRegion = ptRegion;
+    this.Source.ptTile = ptSource;
+    this.wMode = ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, __API_MCMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE);
+    this.Mask.ptSourceSide = ptSrcMask;
+    this.Mask.ptTargetSide = ptDesMask;
+
+    return __arm_2d_op_invoke((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis);
+}
+
+
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MCMM_SW_FUNC(tile_copy_with_masks)( __arm_2d_sub_task_t *ptTask)
+{
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MCMM_OP_TYPE, ptTask->ptOP);
+    assert(__API_MCMM_COLOUR_SZ == OP_CORE.ptOp->Info.Colour.u3ColourSZ);
+
+    //! this should not happen
+    assert(!(   (NULL == this.Mask.ptSourceSide) 
+            &&  (NULL == this.Mask.ptTargetSide)));
+
+    if (    (ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.bInvalid)
+       ||   (ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.bInvalid)) {
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
+    }
+
+    if (    (   ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 
+            ==  ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tColour.chScheme)
+       &&   (   ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 
+            ==  ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tColour.chScheme)) {
+    #if __ARM_2D_CFG_SUPPORT_COLOUR_CHANNEL_ACCESS__
+        /*! \note both masks use ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 format
+         *! 
+         *! \note 1 horizontal line target mask in ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 is not 
+         *!       supported when ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize.iHeight is larger
+         *!       than 1 line.
+         */
+
+        assert (    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize.iHeight
+               >=   ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize.iHeight);
+
+            __MCMM_IMPL_FUNC(src_chn_msk_des_chn_msk_copy)(
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.iStride,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride,
+
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+
+    #else
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_COLOUR;
+    #endif
+
+    } else if (    (   ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 
+                   ==  ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tColour.chScheme)
+           &&   (   ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 
+                   !=  ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tColour.chScheme)) {
+
+    #if __ARM_2D_CFG_SUPPORT_COLOUR_CHANNEL_ACCESS__
+        /*! only the source mask uses ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 format */
+
+        if (ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize.iHeight > 1) {
+            __MCMM_IMPL_FUNC(src_chn_msk_des_msk_copy)(
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.iStride,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride,
+
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+        } else {
+            __MCMM_IMPL_FUNC(src_chn_msk_1h_des_msk_copy)(
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.iStride,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride,
+
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+        }
+
+    #else
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_COLOUR;
+    #endif
+
+    } else if (    (   ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 
+                   !=  ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tColour.chScheme)
+           &&   (   ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 
+                   ==  ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tColour.chScheme)) {
+
+    #if __ARM_2D_CFG_SUPPORT_COLOUR_CHANNEL_ACCESS__
+        /*! \note only the target mask uses ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 format 
+         *! 
+         *! \note 1 horizontal line target mask in ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 is not 
+         *!       supported when ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize.iHeight is larger
+         *!       than 1 line.
+         */
+
+        assert (    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize.iHeight
+               >=   ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize.iHeight);
+
+        __MCMM_IMPL_FUNC(src_msk_des_chn_msk_copy)(
+            ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+            ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.iStride,
+
+            ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+            ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+            &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+            ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+            ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride,
+
+
+            ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.pBuffer,
+            ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.iStride,
+            &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+            &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+
+    #else
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_COLOUR;
+    #endif
+
+    } else {
+        assert(     ARM_2D_COLOUR_8BIT 
+              ==    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tColour.chScheme);
+        assert(     ARM_2D_COLOUR_8BIT 
+              ==    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tColour.chScheme);
+
+        if (ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize.iHeight > 1) {
+            __MCMM_IMPL_FUNC(masks_copy)(
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.iStride,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride,
+
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+        } else {
+            __MCMM_IMPL_FUNC(src_msk_1h_des_msk_copy)(
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.iStride,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride,
+
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+        }
+    }
+
+    return arm_fsm_rt_cpl;
+}
+

+#undef ___MCMM_API_FUNC
+#undef __MCMM_API_FUNC
+
+#undef ____MCMM_SW_FUNC
+#undef ___MCMM_SW_FUNC
+#undef __MCMM_SW_FUNC
+

+#undef ____MCMM_IMPL_FUNC
+#undef ___MCMM_IMPL_FUNC
+#undef __MCMM_IMPL_FUNC
+

+#undef __API_MCMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE
+#undef __API_MCMM_OP_IDX
+#undef __API_MCMM_OP_TYPE
+#undef __API_MCMM_OP
+#undef __API_MCMM_COLOUR_SZ
+#undef __API_MCMM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE
+#undef __API_MCMM_COLOUR

+

+#define ____MCSMM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)                               \
+            ___MCSMM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)
+#define __MCSMM_OPCODE                                                           \

+                            __API_MCSMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE,                   \
+                            __API_MCSMM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE)

+            __arm_2d_impl_##__COLOUR##_##__NAME##_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MCSMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                           \
+            ____MCSMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)

+            __arm_2d_##__COLOUR##_sw_##__NAME##_and_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MCSMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                             \
+            ____MCSMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MCSMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME)                                                  \
+            ___MCSMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MCSMM_COLOUR, __API_MCSMM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+

+#define ____MCSMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                           \
+            arm_2dp_##__COLOUR##_##__NAME##_and_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MCSMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                            \
+            ____MCSMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MCSMM_API_FUNC(__NAME)                                                 \
+            ___MCSMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MCSMM_COLOUR, __API_MCSMM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+

+            ARM_2D_COLOUR_##__COLOUR
+#define __MSCMM_COLOR_TYPE(__COLOUR)        ____MSCMM_COLOR_TYPE(__COLOUR)
+
+ARM_NONNULL(2,3)
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MCSMM_API_FUNC(tile_copy_with_src_mask)(
+                                        __API_MCSMM_OP_TYPE *ptOP,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptSource,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptSrcMask,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptTarget,
+                                        const arm_2d_region_t *ptRegion)
+{
+    assert(NULL != ptSource);
+    assert(NULL != ptSrcMask);
+    assert(NULL != ptTarget);
+
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MCSMM_OP_TYPE, ptOP);
+
+    arm_2d_err_t tErr = __arm_mask_validate(
+                                ptSource, 
+                                ptSrcMask,
+                                ptTarget, 
+                                NULL, 
+                                ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, 
+                                            __API_MCSMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE));
+    if (tErr < 0) {
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)tErr;
+    }
+
+#if __ARM_2D_CFG_SUPPORT_CCCA8888_IMPLICIT_CONVERSION__
+    arm_2d_tile_t *ptSourceRoot = arm_2d_tile_get_root(ptSource, NULL, NULL);
+    if (NULL == ptSourceRoot) {
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
+    }
+    if (ptSourceRoot->tInfo.bHasEnforcedColour) {
+        switch (ptSourceRoot->tInfo.tColourInfo.chScheme) {
+            case __MSCMM_COLOR_TYPE(__API_MCSMM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE):
+            case ARM_2D_COLOUR_CCCA8888:
+                /* code */
+                break;
+
+            default:
+                return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_NOT_SUPPORT;
+                //break;
+        }
+    }
+#endif
+
+    if (!__arm_2d_op_acquire((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis)) {
+        return arm_fsm_rt_on_going;
+    }
+
+    //memset(ptThis, 0, sizeof(*ptThis));
+
+    OP_CORE.ptOp = &__MCSMM_OPCODE;
+
+    this.Target.ptTile = ptTarget;
+    this.Target.ptRegion = ptRegion;
+    this.Source.ptTile = ptSource;
+    this.wMode = ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, __API_MCSMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE);
+    this.Mask.ptSourceSide = ptSrcMask;
+    this.Mask.ptTargetSide = NULL;
+
+    return __arm_2d_op_invoke((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis);
+}
+
+
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MCSMM_SW_FUNC(tile_copy_with_src_mask)( __arm_2d_sub_task_t *ptTask)
+{
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MCSMM_OP_TYPE, ptTask->ptOP);
+    assert(__API_MCSMM_COLOUR_SZ == OP_CORE.ptOp->Info.Colour.u3ColourSZ);
+
+    //! this should not happen
+    assert(NULL != this.Mask.ptSourceSide);
+
+    if (ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.bInvalid) {
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
+    }
+
+#if __ARM_2D_CFG_SUPPORT_CCCA8888_IMPLICIT_CONVERSION__
+    arm_2d_tile_t *ptSourceRoot = arm_2d_tile_get_root(this.Source.ptTile, NULL, NULL);
+    assert(NULL != ptSourceRoot);
+    if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_CCCA8888 == ptSourceRoot->tInfo.tColourInfo.chScheme) {
+
+        if (ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 == ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tColour.chScheme) {
+
+        #if __ARM_2D_CFG_SUPPORT_COLOUR_CHANNEL_ACCESS__
+            if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_SZ_8BIT == __API_MCSMM_COLOUR_SZ) {
+                __arm_2d_impl_ccca8888_tile_copy_to_gray8_with_src_chn_mask(
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.iStride,
+
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                    &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride,
+
+                    &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+
+            }
+            if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_SZ_16BIT == __API_MCSMM_COLOUR_SZ) {
+                __arm_2d_impl_ccca8888_tile_copy_to_rgb565_with_src_chn_mask(
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.iStride,
+
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                    &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride,
+
+                    &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+            }
+            if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_SZ_32BIT == __API_MCSMM_COLOUR_SZ) {
+                __arm_2d_impl_ccca8888_tile_copy_to_cccn888_with_src_chn_mask(
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.iStride,
+
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                    &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride,
+
+                    &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+            }
+        #else
+            return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_COLOUR;
+        #endif
+        } else {
+            if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_SZ_8BIT == __API_MCSMM_COLOUR_SZ) {
+                __arm_2d_impl_ccca8888_tile_copy_to_gray8_with_src_mask(
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.iStride,
+
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                    &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride,
+
+                    &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+
+            }
+            if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_SZ_16BIT == __API_MCSMM_COLOUR_SZ) {
+                __arm_2d_impl_ccca8888_tile_copy_to_rgb565_with_src_mask(
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.iStride,
+
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                    &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride,
+
+                    &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+            }
+            if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_SZ_32BIT == __API_MCSMM_COLOUR_SZ) {
+                __arm_2d_impl_ccca8888_tile_copy_to_cccn888_with_src_mask(
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.iStride,
+
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                    &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride,
+
+                    &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+            }
+        }
+
+        return arm_fsm_rt_cpl;
+    }
+#endif
+
+    if (ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 == ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tColour.chScheme) {
+
+    #if __ARM_2D_CFG_SUPPORT_COLOUR_CHANNEL_ACCESS__
+
+            __MCSMM_IMPL_FUNC(src_chn_msk_copy)(
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.iStride,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride,
+
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+    #else
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_COLOUR;
+    #endif
+    } else {
+        assert(     ARM_2D_COLOUR_8BIT 
+              ==    ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tColour.chScheme);
+
+            __MCSMM_IMPL_FUNC(src_msk_copy)(
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tSource.iStride,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopyMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tCopyMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_copy_t.tTarget.iStride,
+
+                &ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize);
+
+    }
+
+    return arm_fsm_rt_cpl;
+}
+

+#undef ____MCSMM_API_FUNC
+#undef ___MCSMM_API_FUNC
+#undef __MCSMM_API_FUNC
+
+#undef ____MCSMM_SW_FUNC
+#undef ___MCSMM_SW_FUNC
+#undef __MCSMM_SW_FUNC
+
+
+#undef ____MCSMM_IMPL_FUNC
+#undef ___MCSMM_IMPL_FUNC
+#undef __MCSMM_IMPL_FUNC
+

+#undef __API_MCSMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE
+#undef __API_MCSMM_OP_IDX
+#undef __API_MCSMM_OP_TYPE
+#undef __API_MCSMM_OP
+#undef __API_MCSMM_COLOUR_SZ
+#undef __API_MCSMM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE
+#undef __API_MCSMM_COLOUR
+#undef __API_MCSMM_INT_TYPE
+#undef __MSCMM_COLOR_TYPE

+#   error You have to define __API_MFM_COLOUR before using this c template
+#endif
+#ifndef __API_MFM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE
+#   error You have to define __API_MFM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE before using this c template
+#endif
+#ifndef __API_MFM_COLOUR_SZ
+#   error You have to define __API_MFM_COLOUR_SZ before using this c template
+#endif
+#ifndef __API_MFM_INT_TYPE
+#   error You have to define the __API_MFM_INT_TYPE before using this c template
+#endif
+#ifndef __API_MFM_OP
+#   error You have to define __API_MFM_OP before using this c template
+#endif

+#ifndef __API_MFM_IO_COPY

+#endif
+#ifndef __API_MFM_IO_FILL

+#endif

+#endif

+#endif
