+#endif
+
+#undef ____MFM_OPCODE
+#define ___MFM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)    __OP##_##__MIRROR##_##__COLOUR
+
+#undef __MFM_OPCODE
+#define ____MFM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)                                \
+            ___MFM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)
+#define __MFM_OPCODE                                                            \
+            ____MFM_OPCODE(  __API_MFM_OP,                                      \
+                            __API_MFM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE,                    \
+                            __API_MFM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE)
+
+#undef ____MFM_IMPL_FUNC
+#undef ___MFM_IMPL_FUNC
+#undef __MFM_IMPL_FUNC
+#define ____MFM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                           \
+            __arm_2d_impl_##__COLOUR##_##__NAME##_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MFM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                            \
+            ____MFM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MFM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME)                                                 \
+            ___MFM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MFM_COLOUR, __API_MFM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+
+
+#undef ____MFM_SW_FUNC
+#undef ___MFM_SW_FUNC
+#undef __MFM_SW_FUNC
+#define ____MFM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                             \
+            __arm_2d_##__COLOUR##_sw_##__NAME##_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MFM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                              \
+            ____MFM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MFM_SW_FUNC(__NAME)                                                   \
+            ___MFM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MFM_COLOUR, __API_MFM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+
+#undef ____MFM_API_FUNC
+#undef ___MFM_API_FUNC
+#undef __MFM_API_FUNC
+#define ____MFM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                            \
+            arm_2dp_##__COLOUR##_##__NAME##_with_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MFM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                             \
+            ____MFM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MFM_API_FUNC(__NAME)                                                  \
+            ___MFM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MFM_COLOUR, __API_MFM_MIRROR_TYPE)

+                            __API_MFM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE), 
+                __MFM_SW_FUNC(tile_fill));

+const __arm_2d_op_info_t __MFM_OPCODE = {
+    .Info = {
+        .Colour = {
+            .chScheme   = ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_COLOUR_, __API_MFM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE),
+        },
+        .Param = {
+            .bHasSource     = true,
+            .bHasTarget     = true,
+        },
+        .chOpIndex      = ARM_CONNECT(  __API_MFM_OP_IDX,

+
+        .LowLevelIO = {
+            .ptCopyLike = ref_low_lv_io(
+                            ARM_CONNECT(__API_MFM_IO_COPY,
+                                    _,
+                                    __API_MFM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE,
+                                    _,
+                                    __API_MFM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE)
+                        ),
+            .ptFillLike = ref_low_lv_io(
+                            ARM_CONNECT(__API_MFM_IO_FILL,
+                                    _,
+                                    __API_MFM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE,
+                                    _,
+                                    __API_MFM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE)
+                        ),
+        },
+    },
+};
+#endif

+ARM_NONNULL(2,3)
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MFM_API_FUNC(tile_fill)( __API_MFM_OP_TYPE *ptOP,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptSource,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptTarget,
+                                        const arm_2d_region_t *ptRegion)
+{
+
+    assert(NULL != ptSource);
+    assert(NULL != ptTarget);
+
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MFM_OP_TYPE, ptOP);
+
+    if (!__arm_2d_op_acquire((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis)) {
+        return arm_fsm_rt_on_going;
+    }
+
+    //memset(ptThis, 0, sizeof(*ptThis));
+
+    //OP_CORE.ptOp = &ARM_2D_OP_TILE_COPY_ONLY_RGB32;
+    OP_CORE.ptOp = &__MFM_OPCODE;
+
+    this.Target.ptTile = ptTarget;
+    this.Target.ptRegion = ptRegion;
+    this.Source.ptTile = ptSource;
+    this.wMode = ARM_2D_CP_MODE_FILL | 
+                 ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, __API_MFM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE);
+
+    return __arm_2d_op_invoke((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis);
+}
+
+
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MFM_SW_FUNC(tile_fill)( __arm_2d_sub_task_t *ptTask)
+{
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MFM_OP_TYPE, ptTask->ptOP);
+    assert(__API_MFM_COLOUR_SZ == OP_CORE.ptOp->Info.Colour.u3ColourSZ);
+
+#if __ARM_2D_CFG_SUPPORT_CCCA8888_IMPLICIT_CONVERSION__                         \
+&&  defined(RTE_Acceleration_Arm_2D_Alpha_Blending)                             
+
+    arm_2d_tile_t *ptSourceRoot = arm_2d_tile_get_root(this.Source.ptTile, NULL, NULL);
+    assert(NULL != ptSourceRoot);
+    if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_CCCA8888 == ptSourceRoot->tInfo.tColourInfo.chScheme) {
+        if (ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, __API_MFM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE) == ARM_2D_CP_MODE_COPY) {
+
+            if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_SZ_8BIT == __API_MFM_COLOUR_SZ) {
+                __arm_2d_impl_ccca8888_tile_fill_to_gray8(
+                                ptTask->Param.tFill.tSource.pBuffer,
+                                ptTask->Param.tFill.tSource.iStride,
+                                &ptTask->Param.tFill.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+                                ptTask->Param.tFill.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                                ptTask->Param.tFill.tTarget.iStride,
+                                &ptTask->Param.tFill.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize);
+            }
+
+            if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_SZ_16BIT == __API_MFM_COLOUR_SZ) {
+                __arm_2d_impl_ccca8888_tile_fill_to_rgb565(
+                                ptTask->Param.tFill.tSource.pBuffer,
+                                ptTask->Param.tFill.tSource.iStride,
+                                &ptTask->Param.tFill.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+                                ptTask->Param.tFill.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                                ptTask->Param.tFill.tTarget.iStride,
+                                &ptTask->Param.tFill.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize);
+            }
+
+            if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_SZ_32BIT == __API_MFM_COLOUR_SZ) {
+                __arm_2d_impl_ccca8888_tile_fill_to_cccn888(
+                                ptTask->Param.tFill.tSource.pBuffer,
+                                ptTask->Param.tFill.tSource.iStride,
+                                &ptTask->Param.tFill.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+                                ptTask->Param.tFill.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                                ptTask->Param.tFill.tTarget.iStride,
+                                &ptTask->Param.tFill.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize);
+            }
+
+            return arm_fsm_rt_cpl;
+        } else {
+            return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_COLOUR;
+        }
+    }
+
+#endif
+
+    __MFM_IMPL_FUNC(fill)    (  ptTask->Param.tFill.tSource.pBuffer,
+                                ptTask->Param.tFill.tSource.iStride,
+                                &ptTask->Param.tFill.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+                                ptTask->Param.tFill.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                                ptTask->Param.tFill.tTarget.iStride,
+                                &ptTask->Param.tFill.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize);
+
+    return arm_fsm_rt_cpl;
+}
+
+
+#undef ____MFM_API_FUNC
+#undef ___MFM_API_FUNC
+#undef __MFM_API_FUNC

+#define ___MFKM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)    __OP##_##__MIRROR##_##__COLOUR
+
+#undef __MFKM_OPCODE
+#define ____MFKM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)                               \
+            ___MFKM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)
+#define __MFKM_OPCODE                                                           \
+            ____MFKM_OPCODE(  __API_MFKM_OP,                                    \
+                            __API_MFKM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE,                   \
+                            __API_MFKM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE)
+

+#undef __MFKM_IMPL_FUNC

+#define ___MFKM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                           \
+            ____MFKM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MFKM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME)                                                \
+            ___MFKM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MFKM_COLOUR, __API_MFKM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+

+            __arm_2d_##__COLOUR##_sw_##__NAME##_and_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MFKM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                             \
+            ____MFKM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MFKM_SW_FUNC(__NAME)                                                  \
+            ___MFKM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MFKM_COLOUR, __API_MFKM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+

+#undef ___MFKM_API_FUNC
+#undef __MFKM_API_FUNC
+#define ____MFKM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                           \

+#define ___MFKM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                            \
+            ____MFKM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MFKM_API_FUNC(__NAME)                                                 \
+            ___MFKM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MFKM_COLOUR, __API_MFKM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+
+
+ARM_NONNULL(2,3)
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MFKM_API_FUNC(tile_fill_with_colour_keying)( __API_MFKM_OP_TYPE *ptOP,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptSource,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptTarget,
+                                        const arm_2d_region_t *ptRegion,
+                                        __API_MFKM_INT_TYPE tColour)
+{
+
+    assert(NULL != ptSource);
+    assert(NULL != ptTarget);
+
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MFKM_OP_TYPE, ptOP);
+
+    if (!__arm_2d_op_acquire((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis)) {
+        return arm_fsm_rt_on_going;
+    }
+
+    //memset(ptThis, 0, sizeof(*ptThis));
+
+    //OP_CORE.ptOp = &ARM_2D_OP_TILE_COPY_ONLY_RGB32;
+    OP_CORE.ptOp = &__MFKM_OPCODE;
+
+    this.Target.ptTile = ptTarget;
+    this.Target.ptRegion = ptRegion;
+    this.Source.ptTile = ptSource;
+    this.wMode = ARM_2D_CP_MODE_FILL | 
+                 ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, __API_MFKM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE);
+    this.wColour = tColour;
+
+    return __arm_2d_op_invoke((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis);
+}
+
+
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MFKM_SW_FUNC(tile_fill_with_colour_keying)( __arm_2d_sub_task_t *ptTask)
+{
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MFKM_OP_TYPE, ptTask->ptOP);
+    assert(__API_MFKM_COLOUR_SZ == OP_CORE.ptOp->Info.Colour.u3ColourSZ);
+
+    __MFKM_IMPL_FUNC(cl_key_fill)(
+                                ptTask->Param.tFill.tSource.pBuffer,
+                                ptTask->Param.tFill.tSource.iStride,
+                                &ptTask->Param.tFill.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+                                ptTask->Param.tFill.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                                ptTask->Param.tFill.tTarget.iStride,
+                                &ptTask->Param.tFill.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize,
+                                (__API_MFKM_INT_TYPE)this.wColour);
+
+    return arm_fsm_rt_cpl;
+}
+

+ * Title:        __arm_2d_meta_fill_with_des_mask_and_mirror.inc
+ * Description:  c code template for tile filling with mirroring and a mask
+ *               on the target side
+ *
+ * $Date:        07. Nov 2022
+ * $Revision:    V.1.0.0
+ *
+ * -------------------------------------------------------------------- */
+
+
+#ifndef __API_MFDMM_COLOUR

+#endif

+#   error You have to define the __API_MFDMM_INT_TYPE before using this c template
+#endif
+#ifndef __API_MFDMM_OP
+#   error You have to define __API_MFDMM_OP before using this c template
+#endif
+#ifndef __API_MFDMM_OP_IDX
+#   error You have to define __API_MFDMM_OP_IDX before using this c template
+#endif
+#ifndef __API_MFDMM_IO_COPY
+#   error You have to define __API_MFDMM_IO_COPY before using this c template
+#endif
+#ifndef __API_MFDMM_IO_FILL
+#   error You have to define __API_MFDMM_IO_COPY before using this c template
+#endif
+
+#ifndef __API_MFDMM_MIRROR_TYPE
+#   error You have to define __API_MFDMM_MIRROR_TYPE before using this c template
+#endif
+
+#ifndef __API_MFDMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE
+#   error You have to define __API_MFDMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE before using this c template
+#endif
+
+#ifndef __API_MFDMM_OP_TYPE
+#   error You have to define __API_MFDMM_OP_TYPE before using this c template
+#endif
+
+#undef ____MFDMM_OPCODE
+#define ___MFDMM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)    __OP##_##__MIRROR##_##__COLOUR
+
+#undef __MFDMM_OPCODE
+#define ____MFDMM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)                              \
+            ___MFDMM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)
+#define __MFDMM_OPCODE                                                          \
+            ____MFDMM_OPCODE(  __API_MFDMM_OP,                                  \
+                            __API_MFDMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE,                  \
+                            __API_MFDMM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE)
+
+#undef ____MFDMM_IMPL_FUNC
+#undef ___MFDMM_IMPL_FUNC
+#undef __MFDMM_IMPL_FUNC
+#define ____MFDMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                         \
+            __arm_2d_impl_##__COLOUR##_##__NAME##_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MFDMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                          \
+            ____MFDMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MFDMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME)                                               \
+            ___MFDMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MFDMM_COLOUR, __API_MFDMM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+
+
+#undef ____MFDMM_SW_FUNC
+#undef ___MFDMM_SW_FUNC
+#undef __MFDMM_SW_FUNC
+#define ____MFDMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                           \
+            __arm_2d_##__COLOUR##_sw_##__NAME##_and_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MFDMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                            \
+            ____MFDMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MFDMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME)                                                 \
+            ___MFDMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MFDMM_COLOUR, __API_MFDMM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+

+#undef ___MFDMM_API_FUNC
+#undef __MFDMM_API_FUNC
+#define ____MFDMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                          \
+            arm_2dp_##__COLOUR##_##__NAME##_and_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MFDMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                           \
+            ____MFDMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MFDMM_API_FUNC(__NAME)                                                \
+            ___MFDMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MFDMM_COLOUR, __API_MFDMM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+
+
+ARM_NONNULL(2,3)
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MFDMM_API_FUNC(tile_fill_with_des_mask)(
+                                        __API_MFDMM_OP_TYPE *ptOP,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptSource,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptTarget,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptDesMask,
+                                        const arm_2d_region_t *ptRegion)
+{
+    assert(NULL != ptSource);
+    assert(NULL != ptDesMask);
+    assert(NULL != ptTarget);
+
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MFDMM_OP_TYPE, ptOP);
+
+    arm_2d_err_t tErr = __arm_mask_validate(
+                                ptSource, 
+                                NULL,
+                                ptTarget, 
+                                ptDesMask, 
+                                ARM_2D_CP_MODE_FILL | 
+                                ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, 
+                                            __API_MFDMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE));
+    if (tErr < 0) {
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)tErr;
+    }
+
+    if (!__arm_2d_op_acquire((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis)) {
+        return arm_fsm_rt_on_going;
+    }
+
+    //memset(ptThis, 0, sizeof(*ptThis));
+
+    OP_CORE.ptOp = &__MFDMM_OPCODE;
+
+    this.Target.ptTile = ptTarget;
+    this.Target.ptRegion = ptRegion;
+    this.Source.ptTile = ptSource;
+    this.wMode = ARM_2D_CP_MODE_FILL | 
+                 ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, __API_MFDMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE);
+    this.Mask.ptSourceSide = NULL;
+    this.Mask.ptTargetSide = ptDesMask;
+
+    return __arm_2d_op_invoke((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis);
+}
+
+
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MFDMM_SW_FUNC(tile_fill_with_des_mask)( __arm_2d_sub_task_t *ptTask)
+{
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MFDMM_OP_TYPE, ptTask->ptOP);
+    assert(__API_MFDMM_COLOUR_SZ == OP_CORE.ptOp->Info.Colour.u3ColourSZ);
+
+    //! this should not happen
+    assert(NULL != this.Mask.ptTargetSide);
+
+    if (ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.bInvalid) {
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
+    }
+
+    if (    ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 
+       ==   ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tColour.chScheme) {
+
+    #if __ARM_2D_CFG_SUPPORT_COLOUR_CHANNEL_ACCESS__
+        /*!  \note 1 horizontal line target mask in ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 is not 
+         *!       supported when ptTask->Param.tCopy.tCopySize.iHeight is larger
+         *!       than 1 line.
+         */
+
+        assert (    ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize.iHeight
+               >=   ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t
+                        .tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize.iHeight);
+
+        __MFDMM_IMPL_FUNC(des_chn_msk_fill)(   
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.iStride,
+            &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.iStride,
+            &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.pBuffer,
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.iStride,
+            &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize);
+
+    #else
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_COLOUR;
+    #endif
+
+    } else {
+        assert(     ARM_2D_COLOUR_8BIT
+               ==   ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tColour.chScheme);
+
+        if (ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize.iHeight > 1) {
+            __MFDMM_IMPL_FUNC(des_msk_fill)(   
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize);
+        } else {
+            __MFDMM_IMPL_FUNC(1h_des_msk_fill)(   
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize);
+        }
+
+    }
+
+    return arm_fsm_rt_cpl;
+}
+
+

+#undef ___MFDMM_API_FUNC
+#undef __MFDMM_API_FUNC
+
+#undef ____MFDMM_SW_FUNC
+#undef ___MFDMM_SW_FUNC
+#undef __MFDMM_SW_FUNC
+
+
+#undef ____MFDMM_IMPL_FUNC
+#undef ___MFDMM_IMPL_FUNC
+#undef __MFDMM_IMPL_FUNC
+

+#undef __API_MFDMM_MIRROR_TYPE
+#undef __API_MFDMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE
+#undef __API_MFDMM_OP_IDX
+#undef __API_MFDMM_OP_TYPE
+#undef __API_MFDMM_OP
+#undef __API_MFDMM_COLOUR_SZ
+#undef __API_MFDMM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE
+#undef __API_MFDMM_COLOUR
+#undef __API_MFDMM_INT_TYPE

+

+#define ____MFMM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)                               \
+            ___MFMM_OPCODE(__OP, __MIRROR, __COLOUR)
+#define __MFMM_OPCODE                                                           \
+            ____MFMM_OPCODE(  __API_MFMM_OP,                                    \
+                            __API_MFMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE,                   \
+                            __API_MFMM_COLOUR_UPPERCASE)
+

+#undef ___MFMM_IMPL_FUNC
+#undef __MFMM_IMPL_FUNC
+#define ____MFMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                          \
+            __arm_2d_impl_##__COLOUR##_##__NAME##_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MFMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                           \
+            ____MFMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MFMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME)                                                \
+            ___MFMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MFMM_COLOUR, __API_MFMM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+

+            __arm_2d_##__COLOUR##_sw_##__NAME##_and_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MFMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                             \
+            ____MFMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MFMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME)                                                  \
+            ___MFMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MFMM_COLOUR, __API_MFMM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+
+#undef ____MFMM_API_FUNC
+#undef ___MFMM_API_FUNC
+#undef __MFMM_API_FUNC
+#define ____MFMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                           \
+            arm_2dp_##__COLOUR##_##__NAME##_and_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MFMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                            \
+            ____MFMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MFMM_API_FUNC(__NAME)                                                 \
+            ___MFMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MFMM_COLOUR, __API_MFMM_MIRROR_TYPE)
+
+
+ARM_NONNULL(2,3)
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MFMM_API_FUNC(tile_fill_with_masks)(
+                                        __API_MFMM_OP_TYPE *ptOP,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptSource,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptSrcMask,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptTarget,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptDesMask,
+                                        const arm_2d_region_t *ptRegion)
+{
+    assert(NULL != ptSource);
+    assert(NULL != ptSrcMask);
+    assert(NULL != ptTarget);
+
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MFMM_OP_TYPE, ptOP);
+
+    arm_2d_err_t tErr = __arm_mask_validate(
+                                ptSource, 
+                                ptSrcMask,
+                                ptTarget, 
+                                ptDesMask, 
+                                ARM_2D_CP_MODE_FILL | 
+                                ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, 
+                                            __API_MFMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE));
+    if (tErr < 0) {
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)tErr;
+    }
+
+    if (!__arm_2d_op_acquire((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis)) {
+        return arm_fsm_rt_on_going;
+    }
+
+    //memset(ptThis, 0, sizeof(*ptThis));
+
+    OP_CORE.ptOp = &__MFMM_OPCODE;
+
+    this.Target.ptTile = ptTarget;
+    this.Target.ptRegion = ptRegion;
+    this.Source.ptTile = ptSource;
+    this.wMode = ARM_2D_CP_MODE_FILL | 
+                 ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, __API_MFMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE);
+    this.Mask.ptSourceSide = ptSrcMask;
+    this.Mask.ptTargetSide = ptDesMask;
+
+    return __arm_2d_op_invoke((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis);
+}
+
+
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MFMM_SW_FUNC(tile_fill_with_masks)( __arm_2d_sub_task_t *ptTask)
+{
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MFMM_OP_TYPE, ptTask->ptOP);
+    assert(__API_MFMM_COLOUR_SZ == OP_CORE.ptOp->Info.Colour.u3ColourSZ);
+
+    //! this should not happen
+    assert(!(   (NULL == this.Mask.ptSourceSide) 
+            &&  (NULL == this.Mask.ptTargetSide)));
+
+    if (    (ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.bInvalid)
+       ||   (ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.bInvalid)) {
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
+    }
+
+
+    if (    (   ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 
+            ==  ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tColour.chScheme)
+       &&   (   ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 
+            ==  ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tColour.chScheme)) {
+
+    #if __ARM_2D_CFG_SUPPORT_COLOUR_CHANNEL_ACCESS__
+        /*! \note both masks use ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 format
+         *! 
+         *! \note 1 horizontal line target mask in ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 is not 
+         *!       supported when 
+         *!       ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+         *!             .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t
+         *!                 .tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize.iHeight 
+         *!       is larger
+         *!       than 1 line.
+         */
+        assert (    ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize.iHeight
+               >=   ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t
+                            .tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize.iHeight);
+
+        __MFMM_IMPL_FUNC(src_chn_msk_des_chn_msk_fill)(   
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.iStride,
+            &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+            &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.iStride,
+            &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.pBuffer,
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.iStride,
+            &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize);
+
+    #else
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_COLOUR;
+    #endif
+
+    } else if (  (  ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 
+                 ==  ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tColour.chScheme)
+              && (  ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 
+                 !=  ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tColour.chScheme)) {
+
+    #if __ARM_2D_CFG_SUPPORT_COLOUR_CHANNEL_ACCESS__
+        /*! \note only the source mask uses ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 format
+         */
+
+
+        if (ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize.iHeight > 1) {
+            __MFMM_IMPL_FUNC(src_chn_msk_des_msk_fill)(   
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize);
+        } else {
+            __MFMM_IMPL_FUNC(src_chn_msk_1h_des_msk_fill)(   
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize);
+        }
+
+    #else
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_COLOUR;
+    #endif
+    } else if (  (  ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 
+                 !=  ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tColour.chScheme)
+              && (  ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 
+                 ==  ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tColour.chScheme)) {
+
+    #if __ARM_2D_CFG_SUPPORT_COLOUR_CHANNEL_ACCESS__
+        /*! \note only the target mask uses ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 format
+         *! 
+         *! \note 1 horizontal line target mask in ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 is not 
+         *!       supported when 
+         *!       ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+         *!             .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t
+         *!                 .tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize.iHeight 
+         *!       is larger
+         *!       than 1 line.
+         */
+        assert (    ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize.iHeight
+               >=   ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                        .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t
+                            .tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize.iHeight);
+
+        __MFMM_IMPL_FUNC(src_msk_des_chn_msk_fill)(   
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.iStride,
+            &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+            &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.iStride,
+            &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.pBuffer,
+            ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.iStride,
+            &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize);
+
+    #else
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_COLOUR;
+    #endif
+
+    } else {
+
+        if (ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize.iHeight > 1) {
+            __MFMM_IMPL_FUNC(masks_fill)(   
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize);
+        } else {
+            __MFMM_IMPL_FUNC(src_msk_1h_des_msk_fill)(   
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tDesMask.tValidRegion.tSize);
+        }
+
+    }
+    return arm_fsm_rt_cpl;
+}

+#undef __MFMM_SW_FUNC

+            __arm_2d_impl_##__COLOUR##_##__NAME##_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MFSMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                           \
+            ____MFSMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR) 
+#define __MFSMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME)                                                \
+            ___MFSMM_IMPL_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MFSMM_COLOUR, __API_MFSMM_MIRROR_TYPE)

+            __arm_2d_##__COLOUR##_sw_##__NAME##_and_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MFSMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                             \
+            ____MFSMM_SW_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)

+            arm_2dp_##__COLOUR##_##__NAME##_and_##__MIRROR
+#define ___MFSMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)                            \
+            ____MFSMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __COLOUR, __MIRROR)

+            ___MFSMM_API_FUNC(__NAME, __API_MFSMM_COLOUR, __API_MFSMM_MIRROR_TYPE)

+ARM_NONNULL(2,3)
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MFSMM_API_FUNC(tile_fill_with_src_mask)(
+                                        __API_MFSMM_OP_TYPE *ptOP,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptSource,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptSrcMask,
+                                        const arm_2d_tile_t *ptTarget,
+                                        const arm_2d_region_t *ptRegion)
+{
+    assert(NULL != ptSource);
+    assert(NULL != ptSrcMask);
+    assert(NULL != ptTarget);
+
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MFSMM_OP_TYPE, ptOP);
+
+    arm_2d_err_t tErr = __arm_mask_validate(
+                                ptSource, 
+                                ptSrcMask,
+                                ptTarget, 
+                                NULL, 
+                                ARM_2D_CP_MODE_FILL | 
+                                ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, 
+                                            __API_MFSMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE));
+    if (tErr < 0) {
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)tErr;
+    }
+
+    if (!__arm_2d_op_acquire((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis)) {
+        return arm_fsm_rt_on_going;
+    }
+
+    //memset(ptThis, 0, sizeof(*ptThis));
+
+    OP_CORE.ptOp = &__MFSMM_OPCODE;
+
+    this.Target.ptTile = ptTarget;
+    this.Target.ptRegion = ptRegion;
+    this.Source.ptTile = ptSource;
+    this.wMode = ARM_2D_CP_MODE_FILL | 
+                 ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, __API_MFSMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE);
+    this.Mask.ptSourceSide = ptSrcMask;
+    this.Mask.ptTargetSide = NULL;
+
+    return __arm_2d_op_invoke((arm_2d_op_core_t *)ptThis);
+}
+
+
+arm_fsm_rt_t __MFSMM_SW_FUNC(tile_fill_with_src_mask)( __arm_2d_sub_task_t *ptTask)
+{
+    ARM_2D_IMPL(__API_MFSMM_OP_TYPE, ptTask->ptOP);
+    assert(__API_MFSMM_COLOUR_SZ == OP_CORE.ptOp->Info.Colour.u3ColourSZ);
+
+    //! this should not happen
+    assert(NULL != this.Mask.ptSourceSide);
+
+    if (ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.bInvalid) {
+        return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
+    }
+
+
+#if __ARM_2D_CFG_SUPPORT_CCCA8888_IMPLICIT_CONVERSION__
+    arm_2d_tile_t *ptSourceRoot = arm_2d_tile_get_root(this.Source.ptTile, NULL, NULL);
+    assert(NULL != ptSourceRoot);
+    if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_CCCA8888 == ptSourceRoot->tInfo.tColourInfo.chScheme) {
+        if (ARM_CONNECT(ARM_2D_CP_MODE_, __API_MFSMM_MIRROR_TYPE_UPPERCASE) == ARM_2D_CP_MODE_COPY) {
+
+            if (    ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 
+               ==   ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tColour.chScheme) {
+            #if __ARM_2D_CFG_SUPPORT_COLOUR_CHANNEL_ACCESS__
+                if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_SZ_8BIT == __API_MFSMM_COLOUR_SZ) {
+                    __arm_2d_impl_ccca8888_tile_fill_to_gray8_with_src_chn_mask(
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.iStride,
+                        &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                        &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.iStride,
+                        &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize);
+                }
+
+                if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_SZ_16BIT == __API_MFSMM_COLOUR_SZ) {
+                    __arm_2d_impl_ccca8888_tile_fill_to_rgb565_with_src_chn_mask(
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.iStride,
+                        &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                        &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.iStride,
+                        &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize);
+                }
+
+                if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_SZ_32BIT == __API_MFSMM_COLOUR_SZ) {
+                    __arm_2d_impl_ccca8888_tile_fill_to_cccn888_with_src_chn_mask(
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.iStride,
+                        &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                        &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.iStride,
+                        &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize);
+                }                
+
+            #else
+                return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_COLOUR;
+            #endif
+
+            } else {
+                if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_SZ_8BIT == __API_MFSMM_COLOUR_SZ) {
+                    __arm_2d_impl_ccca8888_tile_fill_to_gray8_with_src_mask(
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.iStride,
+                        &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                        &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.iStride,
+                        &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize);
+                }
+
+                if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_SZ_16BIT == __API_MFSMM_COLOUR_SZ) {
+                    __arm_2d_impl_ccca8888_tile_fill_to_rgb565_with_src_mask(
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.iStride,
+                        &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                        &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.iStride,
+                        &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize);
+                }
+
+                if (ARM_2D_COLOUR_SZ_32BIT == __API_MFSMM_COLOUR_SZ) {
+                    __arm_2d_impl_ccca8888_tile_fill_to_cccn888_with_src_mask(
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.iStride,
+                        &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                        &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                        ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.iStride,
+                        &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                            .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize);
+                }
+            }
+            return arm_fsm_rt_cpl;
+        } else {
+            return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_COLOUR;
+        }
+    } else 
+#endif
+    {
+        if (    ARM_2D_CHANNEL_8in32 
+        ==   ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tColour.chScheme) {
+
+        #if __ARM_2D_CFG_SUPPORT_COLOUR_CHANNEL_ACCESS__
+
+            __MFSMM_IMPL_FUNC(src_chn_msk_fill)(   
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize);
+
+        #else
+            return (arm_fsm_rt_t)ARM_2D_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_COLOUR;
+        #endif
+
+        } else {
+            assert(     ARM_2D_COLOUR_8BIT
+                ==   ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tColour.chScheme);
+
+            __MFSMM_IMPL_FUNC(src_msk_fill)(   
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tSource.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask.tSrcMask.tValidRegion.tSize,
+
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.pBuffer,
+                ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.iStride,
+                &ptTask->Param.tFillMask
+                    .use_as____arm_2d_param_fill_t.tTarget.tValidRegion.tSize);
+
+        }
+
+    }
+    return arm_fsm_rt_cpl;
+}
